_vertical_note: Lowercase, must match a file in assets/headers/ (insulation, industrial, transportation, marine, construction). Picks the header gradient color for this product's market segment — confirmed these differ per vertical by comparing real shipped catalog files.
intro: One or two sentence product description.
_substrates_note: Set substrates to null to omit the Substrates section entirely (e.g. for non-structural products).
_tech_data_note: Two columns only (Properties/Value) — this matches the actual shipped 177-product catalog, not the 3-column Test Method/zebra-striped variant piloted during the IC947/M-OS764/T310 mockup round, which was never adopted catalog-wide. Each row renders as a solid navy bar, matching the real template exactly.
_product_type_note: One of: tape, canister, cartridge. Determines which optional sections apply (see RULES.md section 12) — tape gets 'Clean Up Information' in left_sections; canister gets recommended_equipment on page 1; cartridge (MS/sealant) gets bead_chart on page 2. This field isn't read by generate_tds.py directly (the optional fields below are what actually drive the template) — it's bookkeeping for the app's UI and for future-you to know which shape a product is.
_recommended_equipment_note: Canister products only (confirmed via IC947). A bullet list rendered as a 'Recommended Equipment' section on page 1, right column, right after Packaging. Leave null for tape/cartridge products.
_bead_chart_note: MS/cartridge sealant products only (confirmed via M-OS764). A list of [bead width, linear yield] pairs, e.g. [["1/8\"", "154 ft"], ["3/16\"", "68 ft"]]. Renders as a 'Bead Chart' section on page 2, left column, immediately after Application Instructions and before Clean Up Information/Storage & Disposal. Leave null for tape/canister products.
_left_sections_note: Tape products include 'Clean Up Information' between Application Instructions and Storage & Disposal (confirmed against real tape-category shipped files) — omit that section for non-tape products unless it genuinely applies.

precautionary._note: Tape products default to the confirmed, non-flagged GHS statement below (verified verbatim against real shipped files) — do not render it as a flagged placeholder. Canister/cartridge products with actual GHS hazard classifications should instead use a 'statements' list (each its own sentence, e.g. hazard + precautionary statements pulled from the SDS and reviewed by a human — never auto-populated from an SDS upload without explicit confirmation) in place of 'text'. If a product's classification genuinely isn't confirmed yet, set confirmed:false and it renders as a flagged orange placeholder instead of asserting one.
precautionary.text: This product is classified as Non-Hazardous under GHS.

_photo_note: Filename of a real product photo placed in assets/, shown in the header. Leave null rather than reuse another SKU's photo/material/color.
